correctness.rationale: An induced pointed extension is specified by its ideal of predecessors and filter of successors with all cross-comparisons strict; homogeneity identifies the comparison pattern with the complete nonalgebraic type over the named base. Passing from an ideal to its maximal antichain gives an equivariant bijection with independent sets of the 2n-cycle. A rotation by k reduces this cycle to length 2 gcd(n,k) (a single adjacency in the 2-vertex case); a rank-preserving reflection folds it along opposite fixed old vertices to a loopless path on n+1 vertices. The cycle and path recurrences give L_{2 gcd(n,k)} and F_{n+3}. Complementation pairs the two one-sided sectors; the empty pair is counted once. Mixed types are indexed by incidence edges, minima, and maxima, respectively: identity fixes all 4n, nonidentity rotations none, and a reflection fixes no incidence edge and exactly two old vertices. This gives the character, including both even-n reflection classes. Burnside gives the quotient formula; the proper-divisor bound d <= n/2 and a union bound give both asymptotics. At n=5 the fixed counts 265, four times 5 and five times 43 give 50 orbits. The supplied verify.py and verification_output.txt describe finite enumeration for n=5..9 and arithmetic checks through 50; inspected, not executed and not relied on for all n.
